titulo: Cuando + the present subjunctive vs cuando + the present indicative
subtitulo: Cuando llegues (it hasn't happened yet) vs cuando llego (it really happens).
regla: Cuando + subjunctive for a future event that hasn't happened yet; cuando + indicative for what really happens, like habits.

bloques.texto: **Cuando** (_when_) can take the present indicative or the present subjunctive, and each one refers to a different kind of action.

filas: a future event that hasn't happened yet
something that actually happens (a habit, a fact)

bloques.texto: With the subjunctive, the other half of the sentence is usually a **future** or a **command**: **cuando sea grande, tendré un huerto**; **cuando vayas al mercado, compra fruta**.
The same rule applies to synonyms of **cuando**, like **cada vez que** and **en el momento en que**.
Tip: if you could replace _when_ with _whenever, as usual_, use the indicative. If it's _when, someday_, use the subjunctive.

lista.en: When I'm older, I'll have a workshop.

lista.es: Cuando ==vayas== a la taquería, tráeme dos de asada.
lista.en: When you go to the taquería, bring me two asada tacos.

lista.es: Cuando ==estemos== de vacaciones, no usaré el celular.
lista.en: When we're on vacation, I won't use my phone.

lista.es: Cuando tus primos ==lleguen==, ya será tarde.
lista.en: When your cousins arrive, it'll be late.

lista.es: Cuando ==lleguen== al hotel, deben entregar los papeles.
lista.en: When you arrive at the hotel, you must hand in the papers.

bloques.texto: Two similar sentences. In the first, it really happens; in the second, it's a future idea:

lista.es: Cuando ==voy== a Rosarito, me quedo con Beto.
lista.en: When I go to Rosarito, I stay with Beto. (it happens)

lista.es: Cuando ==vaya== a Rosarito, me quedaré con Beto.
lista.en: When I go to Rosarito, I'll stay with Beto. (future)

lista.es: Cada vez que ==veo== a Luisa, me acuerdo de su hermana.
lista.en: Every time I see Luisa, I remember her sister.

lista.es: Te acordarás de mí cada vez que ==veas== el mar.
lista.en: You'll remember me every time you see the sea.

lista.es: En el momento en que ==llego== al gym, el profe me saluda.
lista.en: The moment I arrive at the gym, the coach greets me.

lista.es: En el momento en que ==llegues== al gym, saluda al profe.
lista.en: The moment you arrive at the gym, greet the coach.

bloques.texto: Don't use the future after **cuando**. English says _when I'm older_, never _when I will be older_; Spanish does the same, with the subjunctive.

filas.t: Cuando seré grande, tendré un huerto.
Cuando sea grande, tendré un huerto.

lista.texto: Other time words with the same rule: [[8294|en cuanto, apenas, tan pronto como]].
Another time word with both moods: [[6994|mientras]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _When you see Beto, tell him hi._
Which one? **Cuando hace viento, no surfeo** or **Cuando haga viento, no surfeo**.
In Spanish: _When we arrive, we'll eat._
